steps.text: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with water; bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain. Refrigerate until cold. Peel and cube potatoes.

Meanwhile, place eggs in a saucepan in a single layer; cover with water by 1 inch. Cover the saucepan; bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from the heat and let eggs stand in hot water for 15 minutes. Remove eggs from hot water, cool under cold water, peel, and chop; set aside.

Combine mayonnaise, dressing, relish, mustard, salt, black pepper, paprika, and celery seeds in a large bowl. Add potatoes, eggs, onion, pepperoncini, and olives; stir until well combined. Cover the bowl; refrigerate before serving, at least 2 hours.

raw_recipe.headline: The Best Potato Salad
raw_recipe.description: The best potato salad recipe is best when served cold. Ranch dressing, pepperoncini peppers, pickle relish, and olives combine to lend distinct flavor.

review.reviewBody: I normally go for the recipes with high ratings and pictures, but every once in a while I'll try a low numbered one and I'm glad I did this time. Followed this to the tee and it turned out just how I like potato salad, not too mustardee and not too creamy and sweet, just perfect. Give it a shot, I did and I'm glad for it.

I loved this recipe! I didn't add the black olives, but i did add the pepperoncinis. One thing that I was wondering before making this and would like to clarify for anyone else contemplating this recipe is that the pepperoncinis did NOT make the salad spicy at all! Instead, they added the PERFECT ammount of flavor(and I used pretty spicy pepperoncinis). The recipe didn't say what to do with the peppers, so I diced them finely and removed the seeds, and it was gorgeous! My family has zero tolerance for spicy food, and they loved it! This is easily the best potato salad recipe I have ever come across. For best results, refrigerate overnight.

I had to make a few changes to meet the FODMAP diet I'm on for IBS. I substituted sour cream for the buttermilk, spring onions for the onions and banana peppers for the pickles. I never would have thought the banana peppers would be good but they were great. I cooked the potatoes and eggs in my pressure cooker. The spices were spot on. Thanks so much for sharing your recipe!!

This recipe has enough reviews but I had to add just one more. SUPER GOOD. My family does not like celery seed so I used 3/4 tsp of celery salt instead. I also did not use the other salt mentioned in the recipe. I did not add salt to my potatoes while cooking either. This salad is completely different than what I have had before and I really think you could make some money selling it!

I gave this a 5 star even though I haven't eaten it, but because of the dressing. Here's why, ended up with an extra egg and enough dressing to dredge the egg in, OMG was it good, so I immediately boiled up 7 more eggs (for he extra yolk), quartered the recipe and made up some deviled eggs. Man, talk about tasty, added some bacon crumbles and chives. sat them out with the potato salad, everybody raved about both.. thanks for the recipe..

This was excellent! i dislike sweet potato salad, this was not. I didn't add the olives or pepperoncini or the celery seed. I did add about 1/2 cup chopped celery for crunch, subbed dijon mustard for regular and added a bit of dill weed and used 1/3 cup chopped dill pickle instead of dill relish. So good!
Fantastic recipe. I don’t include onions, and cut the ranch slightly.
i prefer mine better. yukon gold potatoes, hard boiled eggs, celery, frenchs mustard, and krafts miracle whip. a splash of dill pickle juice, salt and pepper. FANTASTIC!!! 5 stars is for my recipe.

Great potato salad, this will be a go-to! I did substitute out plain Greek yogurt for 3/4 of the mayonnaise to make it *slightly* less caloric and left out the olives. I DID include the pepperoncinis and I really feel like those are what makes this recipe stand out! I didn't have a lot of time to prepare it last night so it only sat after being prepared for about an hour and it was still delicious. Served it to a crowd and almost everyone went back for seconds, and my husband raved about it all night!

Tried for the first time and took to a party. Everyone raved about how unique the flavor was, some who said they did not like potato salad, tried it and loved it. Firm red potatoes and the extra kick of pepper chinos was the key to that experience. I boiled an additional 3 eggs to decorate the top with reserved black olives and pepper chinos. I also added celery for that more crunchy texture. Easily my favorite and will use as my "go to" special dish!

I'm not a fan of ranch dressing but had some I needed to use up, so I made this. I will say the sauce tasted too ranchy after initially mixing, but once it was in with the potatoes and eggs, the ranch became more mild. I skipped the onion and celery seed and optional items since I didn't have any of those. I added actual celery chopped into small pieces for added crunch and flavor

The only thing I did different was used our dill pickles we canned from the garden....flavor is phenomenal. Left out the black olives, because my son and wife hate them. Thats it. This is outstanding tater salad!!!
My husband says that this is the best potato salad he has had.

I love this recipe. Made it exactly as the directions listed. I diced up pepperoncini and black olives and served them on the side. It was an incredible hit and very unexpected treat with the extras on the side. The family wants this to be at the next gathering, I'll have to double the recipe. First empty bowl on the table!
Have to omit the onion. Use apples instead.

This is the only potato salad recipe I've used for the past few years. The slight ranch flavor gives it a great flavor and all the other ingredients are the right proportion. Making it for the 4th of July picnic.
